limits: TTM diluted EPS/shares intentionally null. Quarterly and annual EPS/shares are directly reported, never added.
Financial expense is broader than interest expense. FY2020–25 interest expense is separately selected from the financial expense note; quarterly interest is not separately selected.
Drydock_other_capex includes drydock, scrubbers, ballast water treatment and other vessel-related payments where reported; not a pure maintenance number.
Cash flow after reported capex excludes replacement-fleet reserve, lease purchase/reclassification cash flows, and future committed newbuilds. It is not sustainable owner earnings.
EBIT ex vessel gains removes only reported vessel-sale gains/losses; historical impairment and scrubber write-offs remain.
Zero acquisition capex means no separately reported vessel acquisition/construction cash flow in complete investing statement, not no economic fleet investment.
